name: RSI(2) extreme with RSI-50 centerline confirmation
author: StockCharts ChartSchool modification of Connors RSI(2)
license: StockCharts ChartSchool educational text; paraphrased, not copied
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
entry_long: Close > SMA(200); RSI(2) first falls to <= 5; then wait for RSI(2) to move back above 50 and enter long.
entry_short: Close < SMA(200); RSI(2) first rises to >= 95; then wait for RSI(2) to fall back below 50 and enter short. Signal is void if price has meanwhile crossed back above SMA(200).
exit: Source does not restate exit for the filtered variant; base Connors exit (close > SMA5) is the implied choice.
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: SMA(200) trend, RSI(2) extreme then 50-line confirmation
implementation_notes: Exit and stop are not explicitly stated for this variant, so spec is marked incomplete.
